Math formula compendium

Formulas, theorems and rules explained step by step — a free reference for university students and entrance exams

A compendium of the formulas and theorems you need from the last years of school to the first year of university: every card says what the symbols mean, why the formula is true and how to use it in a worked example. Open any formula on the interactive blackboard for an animated, step-by-step explanation with graphs and figures, and an exercise to check yourself — useful to revise for a math test, the SAT, A-levels, the Bac, the Selectividad (EBAU/PAU), the Gaokao, JEE or university exams.
